scope: Offline harness using actual component class methods and compiled source CSS; synthetic API and DOM rendering adapters. Ember, Rails, composer, browser history and production were not booted.
checks: Header and timeline show only the compact current / total index
Default preview contains the first three replies
Collapse button uses only the requested short label
100-deep fixture expands in pages of 50, with each reply rendered once at depth one
Collapse restores the first three replies
Original preview is capped at two lines, retains canonical link and caches successful loads
Target page shows its missing-page gap and retries the earlier page without losing the target
Unavailable original reveals no body and retry recovers
Discussion index resolves to the actual root floor before canonical navigation
A destroyed navigation cannot route after an outstanding request resolves
Desktop and 390/320px mobile, light and dark: no horizontal overflow, natural 33px indent, floating group timeline within viewport
One-pixel straight branches meet reply avatars; the trunk starts at the parent avatar, remains aligned through the group and ends at the last avatar
